title: one list sorted under three collations, and five ways to compare without case, on a real server

steps.sql: SELECT w FROM words ORDER BY w COLLATE "C"
steps.note: C: byte order. every capital before every small letter, and anything accented after z.

steps.sql: SELECT w FROM words ORDER BY w COLLATE "en-US-x-icu"
steps.note: english: letters first, then accents, then case. Å is an A with a ring, Ö an O with dots, so they sort with A and O.

steps.sql: SELECT w FROM words ORDER BY w COLLATE "sv-SE-x-icu"
steps.note: swedish: Å and Ö are letters of their own, after z. Ångström and Öl go to the end.

steps.sql:
SELECT m.method, m.a AS "zoe, ZOE", m.b AS "Zoë, ZOË", m.c AS "zoe, Zoë"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'a = b',               'zoe' = 'ZOE',                   'Zoë' = 'ZOË',                   'zoe' = 'Zoë'),
  (2, 'lower(a) = lower(b)', lower('zoe') = lower('ZOE'),     lower('Zoë') = lower('ZOË'),     lower('zoe') = lower('Zoë')),
  (3, 'citext',              'zoe'::citext = 'ZOE'::citext,   'Zoë'::citext = 'ZOË'::citext,   'zoe'::citext = 'Zoë'::citext),
  (4, 'COLLATE ci',          'zoe' = 'ZOE' COLLATE ci,        'Zoë' = 'ZOË' COLLATE ci,        'zoe' = 'Zoë' COLLATE ci),
  (5, 'COLLATE ai_ci',       'zoe' = 'ZOE' COLLATE ai_ci,     'Zoë' = 'ZOË' COLLATE ai_ci,     'zoe' = 'Zoë' COLLATE ai_ci)
) AS m (n, method, a, b, c)
ORDER BY m.n
steps.note: three pairs, five ways to compare them. this server's ctype is C, so lower() and citext only fold ASCII letters.
